## PAGE_SIZE_LIMITS variable

The bounds on a page's size, the same on every surface.

**Signature:**

```typescript
PAGE_SIZE_LIMITS: {
    readonly default: number;
    readonly maximum: number;
}
```

## Remarks

Chosen from measurement on the slowest supported list (phases/13 D10): a page of `maximum` items finishes well inside the default executor time limit, and a page of `default` items finishes inside it even when the app is several times slower than usual.
